title: elymus caninus subsp. biflorus
intro: Elymus caninus subsp. biflorus, commonly known as Biflorous Dog's Tail, is a subspecies of grass within the Elymus caninus species. It is a type of flowering plant native to Europe, used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Biflorous Dog's Tail include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic and sedative effects.
